settings.title: Settings
settings.check_updates_on_startup: Check for updates when ExaTerm starts
settings.check_updates_on_startup_desc: Checks the latest published stable release once at startup; updates are installed only after confirmation
settings.connection_history_enabled_desc: Save connection settings locally after successful manual or recent SSH/Telnet connections. Saved profile connections are excluded. Turning this off keeps existing history.
settings.connection_history_count_unknow: Could not read the saved history count
settings.connection_history_privacy: Hosts, usernames, private-key paths, and related settings are stored locally as plaintext. Passwords and passphrases are not saved.
settings.connection_history_clear_confir: Clear all saved SSH and Telnet connection history?
settings.connection_history_load_failed: Failed to load connection history. Clear all history to reset the history file.
settings.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
settings.shortcuts.help: Select an assignment and press a shortcut. Printable keys require Ctrl or Alt; F1–F12 can be assigned by themselves.
settings.shortcuts.invalid: Use Ctrl or Alt with a printable key, or use F1–F12.
settings.shortcuts.conflict: This shortcut is already assigned to {{action}}.
settings.ai_provider_status_note: Shows saved configuration status only; connection is not tested.
settings.azure_openai_enabled_desc: Uses the Azure OpenAI v1 API with the configured model deployment
settings.ollama_enabled_desc: When enabled, available Ollama models are shown in the AI panel
settings.mcp_enabled_desc: Master permission for trusted local CLI and MCP clients; enable each interface separately
settings.mcp_children_disabled_desc: Enable external control to change these interfaces.
settings.mcp_stdio_enabled_desc: Lets local MCP clients launch exaterm-mcp and use the existing MCP integration through the ExaTerm GUI
settings.mcp_cli_enabled_desc: Primary external-control path for trusted local processes using exaterm-cli
settings.mcp_connect_enabled_desc: Lets trusted external-control clients open saved SSH/Telnet profiles and Serial consoles
settings.ssh_algorithm_mode_desc: Applies to new direct, jump-host, and externally started SSH connections.
settings.ssh_algorithm_catalog_failed: Could not load the available SSH algorithms.
settings.ssh_algorithm_custom_desc: Select at least one algorithm in every category. Negotiation uses ExaTerm's built-in priority order.
settings.auto_session_log_desc: Automatically starts a plaintext log for each new SSH, Serial, or Telnet connection
settings.include_log_header_desc: Adds session type, target, mode, and start time at the beginning of new log files
settings.secret_clear_confirm_message: Clear this saved API key from the OS credential store?
settings.secret_clear_failed: Failed to clear the API key.
